Title: Redeem the Lost Soul and Master Discipline

Messages.Author: Bradley of Adelaide
Messages.Body:
When the vampire has been burned does it have it's origial capacity
without the masters or does it stay the same as if the master
disciplines were still on the vampire in torper.

For instance Raven has been burnt with a fortitude master on her and a
dominate master on her and you play a Redeem the lost soul on her do
you gain what her original amount is or what her amount was when she
was burnt?

brad

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Bradley of Adelaide wrote:
> When the vampire has been burned does it have it's origial capacity
> without the masters or does it stay the same as if the master
> disciplines were still on the vampire in torper.

Printed capacity. No mods.

>
> For instance Raven has been burnt with a fortitude master on her and a
> dominate master on her and you play a Redeem the lost soul on her do
> you gain what her original amount is or what her amount was when she
> was burnt?

Raven is a 5 capacity vampire. You gain 2 pool.
